basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of retro toys and wrestling, based in Austin, Texas. I work as a freelance graphic designer and enjoy sharing my passion for vintage collectibles and motorcycles. I'm usually online in the evenings after 7 PM, especially on weekends. Although single, I enjoy connecting with fellow enthusiasts online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Grew up collecting GI Joe figures and have been a wrestling fan since childhood, often attending local wrestling events. Self-taught in graphic design through online courses and YouTube tutorials, with a strong interest in retro gaming and motorcycle maintenance.
